messages:
maya: Morning—quick async standup for eng-security. Drop what you did / blockers / today. Focus: KMS rotation dry-run + outstanding audits. I'll start.

maya: Did: ran a dry-run of the KMS rotation against tenant-prod and staging. Updated the rotation runbook with the failure-mode checklist.
Blocker: staging failed during KV re-encrypt step (see chris logs below).
Today: debug staging EKS IAM mapping, schedule rotation windows in Notion.

ali: Did: completed service-account key audit, flagged 2 long-lived keys (svc-orderproc and svc-analytics).
Action: opened PR #342 to revoke and replace keys, added owners in PR description.
Blocker: need product owner approval for key removal (pinged @product-ops).
Today: follow up on approvals and prepare new short-lived token flow.

chris: Did: ran the repro that caused staging to fail; here's the snippet from the KMS agent logs when re-encrypt started:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z ERROR kms-agent reencrypt failed: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/eks-node/instance-i-0abc is not authorized to perform: kms:GenerateDataKey
    status code: 400, request id: b1c2d3e4
```
Blocker: node role missing kms:GenerateDataKey on the staging key policy.
Today: will try a temporary policy tweak on staging to isolate if it's a role binding problem or the KMS key policy.

vikram: Did: reviewed the IAM mappings in terraform module aws_iam_role_for_service_account changes; found that the IRSA::sts:AssumeRole policy for `security-agent` is missing the externalId condition.
Blocker: need to coordinate with infra for a safe rollout.
Today: I'll open the infra PR with a revert-safe plan and add automated tests for role binding. Expect PR by EOD.

pam: Did: updated the rotation runbook and moved the schedule to Notion (link: https://notion.redwood/sec-rotations). Added a template communication for product teams.
Blocker: need final confirmation on preferred maintenance windows (UTC vs PST).
Today: propose rolling windows: 03:00-05:00 UTC or 22:00-00:00 PST — thoughts? :calendar: 

sec-bot: vuln-scan-bot: nightly dependency scan complete. Created ticket SEC-1215 (3 low, 1 medium) for libs in svc-analytics. No critical findings.

jordan: Did: ran repro tests for data-plane signing evasions.
Blocker: can't run full suite against dedicated-staging cluster; missing kubeconfig access for CI runner (file permission error). Pinged eng-infra and dramatiq on the runner.
Today: will try to get temporary access and re-run the suite. If infra can't unblock, will document test gap in the ticket.

claire: Did: started SOC2 artifact collection; captured rotation proof for prod keys but still need evidence for staging rotations and audit logs for the last 90 days.
Blocker: log retention for staging S3 bucket set to 30 days, compliance requires 90. Need ops change.
Today: filing a compliance request and will add the doc to the SOC folder when confirmed.

maya: Follow-up: @chris when you push the policy tweak, paste the `kubectl describe` and the patched key policy snippet here. We'll gate the rotation on a successful canary (tenant-prod ok + staging repaired).
Also, @pam I'll pick the 03:00-05:00 UTC slot unless anyone objects — gives APAC minimal overlap.

ali: ACK :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the product owner notif and update PR #342 with the rotation timeline.

chris: will post logs + patched policy once I validate the small change in staging (aiming within next 30m).

vikram: PR will include a terraform plan output and a rollback step. ETA EOD.

pam: noted — I'll book the calendar slot tentatively and add a reminder to send pre-rotation comms 48h before.

maya: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, escalate here or ping me directly.
